title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St Catherine University
description: Ten under-21-safe Saint Paul food stops with currently posted late service or restaurant hours.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Snelling
cards.subtitle: 610 Snelling Ave S, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm whether carryout or delivery fits your evening; posted hours extend to midnight daily and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Snelling Avenue pizza option with carryout and delivery listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists this 610 Snelling Ave S location's restaurant hours through midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday; 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Grand
cards.subtitle: 975 Grand Ave, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Check the online menu or place a pickup/delivery order before heading out; the location posts both restaurant and delivery hours until midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A Grand Avenue sandwich location with posted midnight service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's lists restaurant and delivery hours of 10 a.m.–midnight daily for its 975 Grand Ave location.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and delivery hours are posted as 10 a.m.–midnight daily.

cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are posted as 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. daily.
